updates.title: Winchester Town Meeting to weigh 45 articles starting tonight
updates.dek: Sessions continue Nov. 9 and 12, with Nov. 16 held in reserve
updates.body:
Town Meeting members convene at 7 p.m. in the Winchester High School auditorium, 80 Skillings Road, to start on a warrant that runs from the receipt of town reports to a proposed eminent domain taking at Forest Ridge.

## Two prices for Forest Ridge

Article 26 would authorize the town to take about 13.4 acres at Forest Ridge for conservation. The draft motion sets a $2.85 million appraisal ceiling. A separately posted February appraisal valued the land at $3.275 million.

The Select Board discussed the article Nov. 2, including correspondence from the developer and public comments, but took no vote and agreed to revisit it Nov. 5.

## Where the boards stand

The Select Board has recommended favorable action on 18 articles. It voted 4-0 on Nov. 2 to recommend unfavorable action on Article 30, a $50,000 study of the Sanborn Carriage House.

Winchester News had not confirmed a Finance Committee recommendation on any article as of Nov. 3.

## Following along

Each update here reports a floor action or vote after it happens. The warrant tracker has every article’s summary, cost, sponsor, board positions and recorded result.
